name: choose_meal
description: Order/choose a meal. Writes: books the selected menu for the date.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD to order for.

arguments.name: meal_type
arguments.desc: 'snack' | 'lunch' | 'afternoon_snack'.

arguments.name: number
arguments.desc: 1-based menu choice among the chooseable menus (see `get_meals`).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: clear_student_cache
description:
Force refresh of cached student data. Writes: drops the local cache so the
    next student lookup re-fetches from EduPage. Call this after students are
    added/removed from a school, or if `scan_students`/`find_student` seems stale.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School whose cache to clear. Without it, clears ALL schools.

name: custom_request
description:
Send a raw request to the Edupage server using the active session.
    Can perform writes depending on the endpoint — treat as write-capable.

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: 'GET' or 'POST'.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Absolute URL, or a path like '/export/ajax_prevedene_meno.php' (resolved against `https://<subdomain>.edupage.org`).

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Request body (for POST).

arguments.name: headers
arguments.desc: JSON string of extra headers, e.g. '{"Accept": "application/json"}'.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School whose session to use (defaults to the active).

name: download_homework_file
description:
Download one homework attachment to disk. Writes: creates a local file.

    Takes an `url` from `get_homework_material`, fetches it through the school's
    logged-in session and writes it into `dest_dir` (default: a `homework`
    folder under the OS temp dir). An existing file is never overwritten — a
    ' (1)', ' (2)', ... suffix is appended instead.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Absolute attachment URL exactly as returned by `get_homework_material`; the request is authenticated with the school's session.

arguments.name: dest_dir
arguments.desc: Directory to save into, created when missing. Defaults to `<tempdir>/homework` (e.g. `.../AppData/Local/Temp/homework`).

arguments.name: filename
arguments.desc: Save under this name instead of the server-suggested one. Directory components and characters illegal on the filesystem are stripped, so the file always lands directly inside `dest_dir`.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School whose session authenticates the request (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: find_student
description:
Look up a student by first/last/full name using tiered matching. Read-only.
    Without a `subdomain`, searches ALL logged-in schools and returns one result
    per school where the student is found.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: First, last or full student name (also 'Novák V.' short names).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: Restrict the search to one school (default: all logged-in schools in scope).

name: get_day_summary
description:
One-call daily school report for a date (default today): timetable,
    substitutions, missing teachers, grades received that day, meals, homework,
    assignments, absences, news, events, and timeline notifications.

    Composes the individual section tools so you don't need to fire 8-10 calls
    to answer "what happened yesterday at school" or "what's coming tomorrow".
    - If `name`/`student_id` is provided: report for that specific student
      (found across all schools unless `subdomain` scopes it).
    - If omitted: **discovery-first** — for a **parent** this returns a
      lightweight per-school index of the account's children (no per-child
      section fetching), so you can then call per child with `name`/`student_id`.
      Set `full=True` to instead build the full report for every child.
    - If omitted and logged in as student/teacher: report on the logged-in account.
    Every section is isolated — a failure in one section yields {"ok": false, "error": ...}
    without failing the report.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD to report on (default today).

arguments.name: full
arguments.desc: When no `name`/`student_id` is given and the account is a parent, build the full report for every child instead of returning the lightweight per-school index. Costs one section sweep per child.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Student to report for, by first/last/full name. Ambiguous names surface every candidate instead of guessing. Ignored when `student_id` is given; see `find_student` to resolve an id first.

arguments.name: student_id
arguments.desc: person_id of the student (preferred, unambiguous). Found across all schools unless `subdomain` scopes the lookup.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to report on (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_grades
description: Get grades for the logged-in student. Read-only.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

arguments.name: term
arguments.desc: 'FIRST' or 'SECOND' to restrict the term.

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: School-year start year to filter by (e.g. 2025 for 2025/26).

name: get_homework_material
description:
Full body text and attachment list of one homework/assignment material.
    Read-only.

    Fetches the school's material-player page for `superid` and flattens its
    widget tree into plain text plus absolute attachment URLs — the timeline
    notification carries only a short summary, never the assignment body or the
    attachment list, so this is the only way to read what the assignment says.

arguments.name: superid
arguments.desc: Material id, taken from `additional_data.superid` of a notification returned by `get_timeline(category='homework')`.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School whose session to use (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_meals
description:
Get the meal menu for a date. Read-only. Always returns all five meal
    slots (breakfast, snack, lunch, afternoon_snack, dinner) — slots not
    published by the school are ``None``.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_missing_teachers
description: Get teachers missing on a date (default today). Read-only.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_my_students

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_my_timetable
description: Get the timetable for the logged-in user on a date. Read-only.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_next_ringing_time
description: Get the type (break/lesson) and time of the next school-bell ringing. Read-only.

arguments.name: date_time_str
arguments.desc: ISO datetime to search onward from (default: now).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_next_week_timetable
description:
Get the Mon-Fri timetable for next week for the logged-in user,
    grouped by weekday. Read-only.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_periods
description: Get the bell schedule (periods with start/end times). Read-only.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_roster
description:
Get a school roster: students, teachers, classes, classrooms or subjects.
    Read-only.

arguments.name: roster_type
arguments.desc: Which roster to return: 'students' — students in the logged-in user's class (formerly `get_students`). 'all_students' — a short list of all students in the school (formerly `get_all_students`). 'teachers' — all teachers (formerly `get_teachers`). 'classes' — all classes (formerly `get_classes`). 'classrooms' — all classrooms (formerly `get_classrooms`). 'subjects' — all subjects (formerly `get_subjects`).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_school_year
description: Return the current school year (starting year). Read-only.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_student_timetable
description:
Get a student's timetable by first/last name OR person_id. Read-only.
    Without a `subdomain`, searches every school in the discovery scope (the
    configured `EDUPAGE_SUBDOMAINS`, or all logged-in schools when unset) and
    returns one result per school where the student is found — so a student
    attending multiple schools yields separate per-school timetables.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Student's first/last/full name.

arguments.name: student_id
arguments.desc: person_id (preferred — unambiguous, see `find_student`).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: Restrict to one school (default: all logged-in schools).

name: get_subdomains
description:
List the school subdomains available to the logged-in account and the
    server's session status per school, plus overall login state. Read-only.

name: get_timeline
description: Get EduPage timeline notifications, filtered by category. Read-only.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Which event types to return: 'recent' (default) — all currently visible notifications (homework, tests, messages, grades, events...). 'history' — all notifications since `date_from` (incl. older ones). 'homework' — homework assignments (formerly `get_homework`). 'assignments' — homework, tests, exams and projects (formerly `get_assignments`). 'absences' — absence records (formerly `get_absences`). 'events' — upcoming events: trips, excursions, meetings, holidays... (formerly `get_upcoming_events`). 'news' — school news (formerly `get_news`).

arguments.name: date_from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD. Only meaningful for category='history'.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_timetable
description:
Get the timetable for a teacher, student, class or classroom on a date
    (or a date range, see `end_date`). Read-only.

arguments.name: target_id
arguments.desc: person/class/classroom id as returned by `get_roster`.

arguments.name: target_type
arguments.desc: 'teacher' | 'student' | 'class' | 'classroom'.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: Single day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Ignored when `end_date` is given.

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: When set, returns the timetable for every day from `date_str` (default today) to `end_date` inclusive, keyed by date — the equivalent of the former `get_timetable_range`.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: get_timetable_changes
description: Get substitution/timetable changes for a date (default today). Read-only.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: login
description:
Log in to Edupage for a school. Writes: establishes (or replaces) the
    server-side session for that subdomain.

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: How to authenticate: 'credentials' (default) — username/password for a known subdomain. 'auto' — portal auto-detect of the school (formerly `login_auto`). 'session' — build a session from an existing PHPSESSID cookie (formerly `login_from_session`); pass it in `session_id`.

arguments.name: password
arguments.desc: Account password. Falls back to EDUPAGE_PASSWORD.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: PHPSESSID cookie value, required when method='session'.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School subdomain (e.g. 'school'). Falls back to the first value of EDUPAGE_SUBDOMAINS; for method='auto' it is optional and tags the detected school's session.

arguments.name: username
arguments.desc: EduPage account login. Falls back to EDUPAGE_USERNAME.

name: login_all
description:
Log in to one or more schools in a single call. Writes: establishes
    (or replaces) the server-side session for each subdomain.

arguments.name: passwords
arguments.desc: Comma-separated passwords, one per school (or a single one). Falls back to EDUPAGE_PASSWORD.

arguments.name: subdomains
arguments.desc: Comma-separated school subdomains, e.g. 'school1,school2'. Falls back to EDUPAGE_SUBDOMAINS.

arguments.name: usernames
arguments.desc: Comma-separated usernames, one per school (or a single one). Falls back to EDUPAGE_USERNAME.

name: rate_meal
description: Rate a meal. Writes: submits quality/quantity ratings for a date and meal type.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD of the meal.

arguments.name: meal_type
arguments.desc: 'snack' | 'lunch' | 'afternoon_snack'.

arguments.name: quality
arguments.desc: Taste rating, 1-5.

arguments.name: quantity
arguments.desc: Portion-size rating, 1-5.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: scan_students
description:
Discover all students visible to the logged-in account across the discovery
    scope (the configured `EDUPAGE_SUBDOMAINS`, or every school when unset).
    Read-only; uses cached data to avoid redundant API calls.

name: send_message
description:
Send a message to a recipient. Writes: posts a new message on the
    recipient's timeline.

arguments.name: body
arguments.desc: Message text. Must not be empty.

arguments.name: recipient_id
arguments.desc: EduPage id like 'Student123' or 'Teacher456' (see `get_roster`).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: sign_off_meal
description: Cancel an ordered meal for a date. Writes: releases the booking.

arguments.name: date_str
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD to cancel.

arguments.name: meal_type
arguments.desc: 'snack' | 'lunch' | 'afternoon_snack'.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: switch_to_parent
description:
Switch the session back to the parent account (parent accounts only).
    Writes: changes which account subsequent tools operate as.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School whose session to restore (defaults to the active).

name: switch_to_student
description:
Switch the session to a student account (parent accounts only). Writes:
    changes which account subsequent tools operate as.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: first/last/full name of the child, used when `student_id` is omitted.

arguments.name: student_id
arguments.desc: person_id of the child (from `get_my_students`).

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School to query (defaults to the active subdomain).

name: two_factor_finish
description:
Finish a pending 2FA login. Writes: completes the pending auth flow.
    Only needed after a `login` that returned `two_factor_required: True`.

arguments.name: code
arguments.desc: Optional email/app verification code. When given it is used directly; otherwise the device-confirmation flow is polled.

arguments.name: poll_seconds
arguments.desc: How long (seconds) to wait for approval on a device when `code` is not given. Defaults to 60; on timeout the caller can call `two_factor_finish` again later.

arguments.name: subdomain
arguments.desc: School subdomain whose pending login to complete (defaults to the active subdomain).
